title: arum orientale subsp. danicum
intro: Arum orientale subsp. danicum, commonly known as Danica arum or Danica lily, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Arum. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Arum orientale subsp. danicum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, which have been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedation, analgesia, and vasodilation.
